summary: Attempt c reached and completed the frozen v11 source capture in memory, but failed the exact source-allocation zero-queue attribution gate before releasing any source branch. Consequently it provides no valid HBM reclamation, restore, continuation-correctness, or integrated movement-amplification result.

primary_failure.message: source allocation zero-queue differs from the authenticated capture plan; runtime teardown required
primary_failure.failure_call_site: run_integrated_v11_gpu1 immediately after capture_native_to_transport_v11 and before release_source_and_prove_v11
primary_failure.evidence_loss_reason: The typed exception carried teardown_evidence in process, but the worker failure serializer persisted only exception type, message, and traceback. Therefore the exact observed ID set and the relative contributions of stale, missing, and duplicate IDs cannot be reconstructed scientifically.

root_cause.classification: retained-engine allocator-notification queue was not epoch-separated between readiness/calibration and rollout-source construction
source_sequence: _run_integrated_calibration_phase executes retained-engine readiness and calibration requests on the rollout engine
_reset_probe_state proves empty request queues and calls reset_prefix_cache, but never consumes manager.take_new_block_ids
_prepare_rollouts then allocates the 16K shared-root plus eight private branch lifetimes
consume_exact_source_allocation_queue_v11 performs the first source-bound destructive drain only after the export capture
the drain is required to contain exactly the 1,152 current source IDs once each, so any retained calibration allocation notification or reused-ID duplicate makes it fail closed
root_cause.pinpointed_mismatch: The zero-queue covered a longer retained-engine allocation history than the authenticated source capture lifetime, while the validator correctly required one exact source-lifetime set.
root_cause.important_limit: The attempt-c artifact does not serialize the observed queue count or IDs. The lifecycle boundary defect is pinpointed from the executed code path, but no claim is made about the exact stale-ID count or whether the observed mismatch also contained missing IDs.
